What is Claude AI? Complete 2026 Guide

Claude AI is an artificial intelligence assistant built by Anthropic — one of the leading AI safety research companies in the world. What is Claude AI, exactly? It is a large language model (LLM) capable of understanding and generating human-level text across almost any task: writing, summarising, coding, reasoning, research, and conversation. Claude is available via claude.ai and through an API for developers. Unlike some competitors, Anthropic built Claude with a deliberate emphasis on safety, honesty, and avoiding harmful outputs — making it a strong choice for individuals, businesses, and developers who want a capable and trustworthy AI assistant.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Claude AI?
Claude AI is a large language model (LLM) built by Anthropic. It can read, write, summarise, and reason across a wide range of tasks — from drafting emails to analysing complex documents. It is designed with a focus on safety and helpfulness.
Who made Claude AI?
Claude is made by Anthropic, an AI safety company founded in 2021 by former OpenAI researchers including Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei. Anthropic is headquartered in San Francisco.
Is Claude AI free to use?
Yes, Claude has a free tier available at claude.ai that gives you access to the base model with usage limits. Paid plans (Claude Pro) unlock higher limits, access to more powerful models like Claude Opus, and priority availability.
